title.narrative: Throughout the year UNICEF reinforced its commitment to improving access to climate-resilient WASH services in 8 regions, benefiting women, men, adolescent girls, and boys in both rural and urban areas. Key achievements, 118,085 additional people gained access to basic water services, and 721,523 people to basic sanitation and hygiene services.
